root.label: Peggy Flanagan wins Minnesota Democratic Senate primary

events.label: Peggy Flanagan wins Minnesota Democratic Senate primary

slots.name: ad spending ratio
slots.sentence: Craig and her allies outspent Flanagan and her camp by four to one on ads, as my colleague Theodore Schleifer pointed out yesterday ; the congresswoman’s loss could be an ominous sign for moderate Democrats who want to compete in blue states in 2028 and beyond.

slots.name: Democratic primary result
slots.sentence: Lt. Gov. Peggy Flanagan handily beat Representative Angie Craig , a centrist who helped her party win back the House in 2018.
